import nanosurf
import time

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get all necessary variables
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Dynamic AFM (tapping mode) to minimize tip damage
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.DynamicAFM

# Set scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # time per line in seconds (51.2s / 128 lines = 0.4s)

print("Scan parameters set:")
print(f"Image size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
print(f"Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines}")
print(f"Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"Total scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} s")
print(f"Operating mode: Dynamic AFM (tapping mode)")

# Start scan
scan.StartFrameUp()
print("\nScanning started...")

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the last saved file path
# The scan should be automatically saved in the gallery
last_file = application.GetLastGalleryHistoryFilename()
print(f"\nSaved file path: {last_file}")

del spm
"}

import nanosurf
import os
import glob

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Try to get the gallery path or working directory
try:
    # Check if there's a method to get the gallery path
    gallery_path = application.GalleryPath
    print(f"Gallery path: {gallery_path}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Could not get gallery path: {e}")

# Try to get current working directory
cwd = os.getcwd()
print(f"Current working directory: {cwd}")

# Look for recently created .nid files in the current directory and subdirectories
print("\nSearching for .nid files...")
nid_files = glob.glob(os.path.join(cwd, "**/*.nid"), recursive=True)
if nid_files:
    # Sort by modification time to get the most recent
    nid_files.sort(key=os.path.getmtime, reverse=True)
    print(f"Found {len(nid_files)} .nid files")
    print(f"Most recent file: {nid_files[0]}")
    print(f"Modified: {os.path.getmtime(nid_files[0])}")
else:
    print("No .nid files found")

del spm
"}
